data.name: Investment Fund Game
data.detailed_description:
Dive into a realistic market simulator where every decision matters!

Investment Fund Game is a singleplayer sandbox simulation where you become the manager of an investment fund. Buy stocks, bonds, commodities. Test different investment strategies, track your performance, and compete with AI-driven funds using their own approaches. Through realistic dashboards, financial reports, and market simulations, you’ll gain a better understanding of how investments work, how to build a portfolio, and how market psychology (fear and greed) shapes decisions.

Key Features
📊 Realistic financial dashboards – manage your fund just like a professional.
💼 Portfolio management – diversify between stocks, bonds, commodities, and more.
📈 Market simulation – experience volatility, booms, bubbles, and crashes.
🤖 Competitors – go head-to-head with funds that follow different strategies.
📰 Educational content – in-game articles and strategy guides help you learn investing concepts.
🏆 Rankings – compare your fund’s performance to competitors and track your growth over time. Will you achieve alpha and outperform the market, or will fear and greed destroy your portfolio?



Investment Fund Game is planned to launch in Early Access in Q2–Q3 2026.

Join our Discord to share feedback and shape Early Access - find it in the Links section on this store page (Discord icon)


Disclaimer:
This game is a fictional simulation created for educational and entertainment purposes only. All companies, financial instruments, and market data presented in the game are fictional and do not represent real-world entities. The game does not provide financial advice and should not be used as a basis for real investment decisions. Any resemblance to actual persons, companies, or events is purely coincidental.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD / GTX 750
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD / GTX 750
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
